text: The night before a job interview, Tess Marshall arrives at [a house she has booked in Brightmoor, Detroit|trigger|making a new home] and finds a stranger named Keith already staying there. Her interviewer warns that the neighbourhood is dangerous, a homeless man shouts at her to leave, and when she locks herself in the basement she [discovers a hidden room with a stained mattress, a bucket and a camera|images|the house and its rooms]. Beyond it a tunnel leads deeper underground, and something down there [wants someone to mother|wants|a child to take or have].
